title: How to Edit the Website Email Signature
text:
## How to Edit the Website Email Signature
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052157
The "General" section of the General Settings can be used to add a signature for the default system emails:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12133632948/original/LVNAGupGx_vOoKQcHJmzaIibX6Dttf5ing.png?1698866306 | alt: ]
This section will only edit the default website emails. There is also an option to add a different signature for the admin operator in the admin settings:
Editing Admin Operators
